status.summary: Veteran flyweight contender and two-time title challenger. His last UFC fight was a third-round rear-naked-choke loss to Alexandre Pantoja for the title at UFC 317 (Jun 28, 2025); the ufcstats snapshot through Oct 31, 2026 shows no fight since, a layoff of more than 16 months. UFC record 8-5. Current status (bookings, injuries, ranking) could not be verified on the web in this pass.

style.summary: A compact orthodox striker with one-punch power (three UFC KO wins) whose numbers show good striking and takedown defense, low accuracy and an above-average share of leg kicks, the profile of a counter-puncher. His losses have come to grapplers who got him down or took his back, and to Moreno's body kick, and he has not fought since mid-2025.

moves.notes: Groups follow his target split in fighters.json: decayed significant attempts 78% head, 11% body, 11% legs (career 80/10/11); landed 62% head, 17% body, 22% legs, against a flyweight prior of about 77/14/9 attempted. Leg kicks are therefore a bigger share for him than for most flyweights, with calf slightly ahead of inside as a judgment (no source separates them). Head-group weights favour the cross and hook because his KO finishes are punches at distance; no technique-level scouting source was found in this pass, so within-group weights are judgments. 93% of decayed attempts are at distance and clinch strikes are 1%, so knees and elbows are near zero. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json, data/raw ufcstats per-fight stats.
